otherText: Remote tax filing lets you complete your tax return without visiting our office. You send your documents securely online, and our team prepares and files your return remotely.
Our remote filing service is available to individuals across Canada, including employees, students, self-employed individuals, newcomers, couples, and families.

Most clients need tax slips such as T4, T5, or tuition slips, along with receipts for RRSP contributions, medical expenses, childcare, rent, or other tax-related documents depending on their situation.
You can submit your documents through our secure remote process. Please make sure your files are clear, complete, and easy to read.
Yes. We handle your personal and financial information with care and use secure methods to collect and process your documents.
The timeline depends on how simple or complex your return is and whether all required documents are provided on time. Simple returns are usually completed faster.
Yes. We can assist with self-employed and more detailed tax situations by reviewing the information you provide and helping prepare your return properly.
